title: Faraday's first law
caption: The mass of copper deposited is proportional to the charge passed. One mole of electrons (96 485 C, one faraday) deposits half a mole of copper, 31.8 g, because Cu²⁺ needs two electrons per atom.
alt: Mass of copper deposited against charge passed: a straight line through the origin, 3.18 g at 9648.5 C.
description: A straight line through the origin: mass ∝ charge.
9648.5 C (0.1 mol of electrons) deposits 3.18 g of copper.
